title: IntakeGuard Policy
description: Declarative intake policy. Missing fields take the strict defaults. Unknown fields are a validation error, so a typo can never silently weaken a policy.

allow.description: Allowlist of detected MIME types. Anything not listed is rejected with TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED.

typeMismatch.description: What to do when the detected type disagrees with the file extension or the claimed MIME type.

maxBytes.description: Cap on input size. It does not limit output size.

maxDecompressedBytes.description: Cap on total bytes produced by decompressing compressed data in one file: PDF streams, and image metadata or ICC chunks. Decoded image pixel buffers are governed by maxImagePixels/maxImageDimension instead (spec 0.1.2).

maxProcessingMs.description: Checked between stages and inside IntakeGuard's own parsers. A single codec call cannot be interrupted (see format-guarantees.md).

mode.description: inspect: verdict only, no output artifact. decode-reencode: produce a new artifact.

metadata.description: remove: strip all metadata classes listed in format-guarantees.md. reject: reject if any is present. keep: only valid with mode=inspect.

outputFormat.description: same: JPEG->JPEG, PNG->PNG, lossless WebP->lossless WebP, lossy WebP->JPEG q90, lossy WebP with alpha->PNG (spec 0.1.3). Or force a format.

applyOrientation.description: Apply EXIF orientation to the pixels before removing metadata (spec 0.1.2).

activeContent.description: JavaScript, OpenAction/AA, Launch, SubmitForm, ImportData, RichMedia, XFA. v0.1 only supports reject.

externalLinks.description: URI actions and remote GoTo. The default is warn because they are common in legitimate documents.

hiddenContent.description: Heuristic flags for likely hidden text. Never a prompt-injection guarantee.

malformed.description: Structural errors such as broken xref or a missing trailer. v0.1 only supports reject.

scanners.description: Optional external scanner hooks (e.g. ClamAV). A scanner can only make a verdict stricter, never more permissive.
